rootRelation.native: the actual case-owned native-fixture absolute directory
rootRelation.sdk: the actual case-owned sdk-fixture absolute directory
rootRelation.boundary: replace a literal root only when followed by slash or end; preceding boundary must be start, whitespace, quote, backtick, open bracket, colon, or equals

typedTransport.setAndMap: retain tagged complete iteration values and entries
typedTransport.messagePort: retain observer channel identity and every actual outgoing message without replacing the port
typedTransport.error: retain actual class, message, codes, causes, attributes and stack in raw; no error-class translation in this Doctor baseline

firstBaseline: Differences in ids, archive layouts, CLI hints and unsupported SDK preview remain genuine reported differences; none is silently removed.

fixtureInputGuardsBeforeOriginalImports.agentInputs: literal owned agent ids and 30m/0m cadence strings only; no provider/model/plugin config
fixtureInputGuardsBeforeOriginalImports.sdkHostMapping: explicit literal agent list and retain_source flag supplied by the fixture, not computed from an imitation of native resolution
fixtureInputGuardsBeforeOriginalImports.sourceMutations: literal owned files, links, chmod and real claim process identities, prepared before a fresh phase
fixtureInputGuardsBeforeOriginalImports.cfg: complete actual native config constructed from those literal owned fixture inputs and retained raw
fixtureInputGuardsBeforeOriginalImports.unknownKindsOrOperations: reject before importing any original module

workerObservers.effect: read-only message/exit observations followed by the same original method with the original receiver and arguments
workerObservers.bootstrap: every actual carrier requires inherited Doctor-only preload, exact Node identity, Date-only fixture clock and the exact original carrier argv entry
